label: 👩‍🍳 Советы домохозяйки
desc: Casual, like chatting with a friend over coffee. Real kitchen / bathroom setting, warm light, problem-solving voice. "I tried this and it actually worked" framing.

label: 📺 Магазин на диване
desc: Late-night infomercial energy. BIG promises, BEFORE/AFTER reveals, "BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE!" beats, bright studio lighting, exaggerated host enthusiasm.

label: 📱 TikTok hook-bait
desc: Mystery first frame, fast cuts every 0.5-1 sec, captions overlay, "I tried this and you won't believe..." opening. Energetic, urgent, attention-snapping.

label: 🔬 Эксперт-расследование
desc: Investigative journalist tone with warm framing. "I tested 12 products so you don't have to — here's what works." B-roll, data overlays, confident voice.

label: 💡 Лайф-хак
desc: Quick 15-30 sec tip with a clever twist. Satisfying ASMR sounds. "Before you throw this away, watch this" — punchline reveal at the end.

label: 📖 Story-mode
desc: Personal anecdote. "I was struggling with X for years, then I tried this…" Vulnerable opening, transformation arc, sincere tone, eye-contact close-ups.

label: 🧪 Science-glamour
desc: Lab-aesthetic + beauty-shoot. Ingredient close-ups, gentle authority voice, "molecularly bonded" / "clinically proven" claims, clean white visuals.

label: 🔩 Garage tinkerer
desc: Workbench setting, tools visible, "let me show you something" energy. Hands-on demo, no marketing speak. Quiet competence — "this is how it actually works".

label: 👔 Workplace pro
desc: "In my 10 years working in X, this is the only one that holds up." Expert-from-the-field framing. Specific examples from real jobs. Zero fluff.

label: 💪 Gym bro / results-mode
desc: Performance-focused, slightly intense. "This actually works — here's the proof." No sugarcoating, metrics over feelings, gym/garage/range setting.

label: 📦 Dad review
desc: Calm honest assessment. "Is it worth it?" framing. Camera-on-shelf shots, practical use cases. "I bought this for X — here's how it held up after six months."

label: ⚙️ Tech breakdown
desc: Disassembly aesthetic. "What's actually inside" energy. Specs, materials, how-it-works callouts. Satisfying engineering reveal — viewer learns something concrete.
